October 5, 2026. A bounded financial experiment on Solana mainnet. Three 0.01 USDC settlements bind saved owned-agent results. The second transfer survived a deliberate process exit; replay created no new payment. All principal returned.
Inference ran locally before settlement. These transfers are test settlements to our own worker, not model-provider bills. The hosted paid-service release remains on hold.
